title: MLAG Consistency Mismatch — DC1_L3_LEAF2 Port-Channel5
symptom: DC1_L3_LEAF2 MLAG config-sanity reports mismatches. Dual-homed hosts seeing asymmetric forwarding. Peer-link is up.
root_cause: VLAN 21 removed from Port-Channel5 allowed list on dc1-leaf2b only, creating a port-channel consistency mismatch between MLAG peers.
fix_command:
interface Port-Channel5
switchport trunk allowed vlan add 21
